s.t: Fix steer queue drop on reconnect
This session is open in another client. You can read along; take over to send.

The queued steers were dropped because the input buffer was cleared on reconnect; `steer_queue.rs` now re-drains the buffer after the socket is re-established, so commands issued offline reach the turn.

## 工作区结构一览

- 根目录 `.` 只有两项：隐藏目录 `.octos` 和配置文件 `.octos-workspace.toml`。
- `.octos` 内含子目录 `dsflash` 和文件 `active-profile`，后者记录当前生效的档案名。
- `.octos-workspace.toml` 共 217 行，开头声明 `schema_version = 1`，并把工作区类型定为会话级。

```toml
[workspace]
kind = "session"
```
